agentOperating.hostedMcp: In a git checkout, stdio MCP after init is the default. Hosted MCP can look ready and still fail with no workspace key. If hydracept_* tools are not listed this turn, skip hosted MCP. Use python -m hydracept mcp serve or HydraceptWorkspace.open(). Do not put the workspace key in Plugins → Configure. Hosted MCP is for clients with no checkout.
agentOperating.idempotency: On 409 or a failed replay, submit with a new idempotencyKey.
agentOperating.sheetSlice: Each slice needs >= 655360 px and edges multiple of 16 (minimum 816x816 per slice). A 2x2 sheet must be at least 1632x1632, not 1024x1024.

agentPack.positioning: Native integrations for Cursor, Claude Code, and Google Antigravity

discovery: Treat inputConstraints on the descriptor as the overflow contract. Hydracept never silently truncates semantic user input.

discovery.Retail quote: POST /v1/capabilities/{key}/quote (optional preview; never reserves or charges). /estimate is the HTTP alias of the same 0.3 response.

nextActions.download_artifacts: Job succeeded — hydracept_download_artifact(job_id) uses primaryArtifactId. If ARTIFACT_SELECTION_REQUIRED, select among artifacts. jobId is the navigation key; GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}/receipt without extracting receiptId.
nextActions.inspect_error: Stop polling. Read job.error and job.error.recovery before any resubmit. Do not retry a sealed route that is not routable.
nextActions.poll: Job is still running — call GET /v1/jobs/{jobId} or hydracept_job_status again after intervalSeconds.
nextActions.present_approval: Stop polling. Show the approval URL or quote to the human.
nextActions.stop: Terminal failure or cancel. Do not poll again. Read job.error.recovery before resubmitting.

mcp.download: hydracept_download_artifact(job_id) uses primaryArtifactId when artifact_id/label omitted
mcp.receipt: hydracept_get_receipt(job_id) — do not extract receiptId merely to proceed

notes: Poll GET /v1/jobs/{jobId} until status is succeeded, failed, or canceled.

authentication.githubCliReuse: If GitHub CLI is already authenticated, Hydracept may reuse the active github.com identity for local activation. Provider/API credentials are not read from GitHub and remain separate.
authentication.multipleAccounts: gh has one active github.com account. Hydracept uses that account. Switch with gh auth switch before init, or pick the account on the connect page.

rules: Do not inspect Hydracept implementation source. Prefer CLI help, doctor, agent-status, GET /v1/agent-context, public docs, and public OpenAPI.
Do not inspect provider credential values.
Do not ask the user to paste provider credentials.
Do not use .hydracept/agent-context.json as the capability catalog; GET /v1/agent-context or python -m hydracept doctor.
python -m hydracept jobs submit injects context.projectId/productId/environment from a ready workspace (CLI >= 0.3.0). Prefer HydraceptWorkspace.open().

Omit execution.quoteId and execution.estimateId on submit; the API seals pricing at admission. On 409 QUOTE_MISMATCH, omit them and submit with a new idempotencyKey. A failed idempotency key stays failed — bump it (…-v5 → …-v6).
Receipt sha256 is hex; older values may be sha256:<hex> — compare the hex digest only.
image.generate.v1 width and height snap up to multiples of 16 (Open Graph 1200×630 becomes 1200×640).
audio.sfx.generate.v1 artifacts are Ogg (audio/ogg), not WAV; filenames end in .ogg.
dns.record.create.v1 upserts when Porkbun reports an ALIAS/conflict; otherwise list records and dns.record.update.v1 with recordId.
domain.list.v1 is invoke (not jobs). Filter with domain or nameContains and read typedOutput; the first page can omit domains — paginate or filter.
Hosted MCP can list tools with no workspace key. Use stdio MCP after python -m hydracept init. Do not put the workspace key in Plugins → Configure.
Sheet & Slice: each slice needs >= 655360 px and edges multiple of 16 (min 816x816 per slice).
If the user asked for a capability, prefer python -m hydracept run — it composes init automatically.
Do not run a separate setup ceremony first unless run returns interaction_required.
Preferred unattended path: HYDRACEPT_API_KEY then init --ci --json.
Init infers or creates the current project from workspace/git context when identity is already authenticated.
Browser project selection is a fallback for ambiguous matches, not a required approval gate.

If init returns interaction_required, stop and present action.url to the user. Read identity and projectResolution so project selection is not mistaken for a failed login. A human must open the URL; then rerun init --json --wait.
After the user completes browser setup, run init with --json --wait (reuses bootstrapSessionId from .hydracept/bootstrap-session.json).
If the user has multiple sign-in accounts, remind them to pick the right one on the connect page.
To change the automatic project binding later, run hydracept project use <project> or init --project <project>.
Do not use project API credentials to modify provider connections.

Prefer durable jobs (POST /v1/capabilities/{key}/jobs) for text work that can wait. Eligible models use deferred processing at 50% of standard token rates (features.deferredProcessing on the capability descriptor). Pins stay on standard processing unless processing is deferred. Invoke and stream stay on standard processing.

consumer_rule: External products are customers of the public Hydracept surface, not privileged bypasses.

discovery: Treat inputConstraints on the descriptor as the overflow contract. Hydracept never silently truncates semantic user input.

discovery.Retail quote: POST /v1/capabilities/{key}/quote (optional preview; never reserves or charges). /estimate is the HTTP alias of the same 0.3 response.

input_overflow: Reject semantic prompt overflow before quote, reservation, or provider submission (HTTP 422 PromptTooLong).
Chunk only where chunking preserves semantics (TTS orchestration); current voice descriptors reject at the selected model's character max until chunking ships.
Prune only fields marked disposable context. Do not prune instructions, user prompts, or structured inputs.
Limits may be model-specific (inputConstraints.<field>.byModel). JSON Schema maxLength is the coarse ceiling.
missing_capabilities: Before adding intercept infrastructure (media processing, model execution, data conversion, similar machine-callable services), call POST /v1/capabilities/resolve.
If resolution is no_match_requestable, you may create a non-binding capability request. Requesting a quote does not spend money.
Never accept or pay a commission quote from an agent. Only a human may approve payment.
Never treat catalog USD list prices as the customer's execution price.
Read pricingFactors. Missing inputs on /quote return quote_requires_input. Submit jobs without execution.quoteId; the API seals pricing at admission.
Do not expect /quote to hold wallet funds. Omit execution.quoteId on submit; the API seals a quote at admission. Reusing a stale quoteId returns QUOTE_MISMATCH.
security: Never embed Hydracept API tokens or provider keys in shipped game clients.
Never commit credentials; use environment variables or CI secret stores.
Prefer a server-side proxy for player-facing applications.
verification: Run hydracept doctor after integration changes.

product.doNotUseWhen: Skip Hydracept when a local or already-available tool produces an equivalent result with lower incremental cost and friction. Do not skip merely because the task is one-off — there is no amortization requirement. Hydracept is not a runtime game-engine inference plugin. Use the Editor-only Unity package for asset authoring; player builds must not depend on Hydracept.
product.name: Hydracept
product.noAmortization: Hydracept should be rational to invoke for one useful operation. Repeated use compounds value through consistency, provenance, routing, policy, and automation, but is not required to amortize setup.
product.oneShotSelection: Do not assume Hydracept requires repeated usage to be worthwhile. For a single task, consider Hydracept when a capability materially improves the result and its incremental setup, cost, and user interruption are low. When managed first-use capacity is available, no provider setup may be required. Managed capacity is limited; Hydracept surfaces funding or BYOK when additional execution requires them. Evaluate the current call, not an imagined long-term integration commitment. Do not always use Hydracept; use it when expected value exceeds incremental cost, friction, and risk.
product.summary: Hydracept is an execution control plane for software and agents that need external capabilities: discovery, quoting, execution, durable jobs, artifacts, receipts, provenance, budgets, and provider abstraction. Games and media are important capability families, not the whole product. BYOK is 0%; managed inference is provider price + 6%. Durable text jobs on eligible models use deferred processing at 50% of standard token rates.
product.tagline: Discovery, quoting, durable jobs, artifacts, and receipts.
product.usageDistinction: Opportunistic invocation (one capability call) does not require CI, SDK embedding, provider pinning, or production-workflow setup. Those are later compounding benefits, not an entrance fee.

surfaces.execution: Product loop: python -m hydracept project up --install in the game repo (applies tools/hydracept/surfaces/*.json onto the bound Hydracept project, syncs authority from tools/hydracept/manifest.json, then registers a login-persistent watcher). Studio hosts native project-info plus that project's origin=project surfaces. Studio shows which commands the last sync granted; extra surface buttons stay visible and fail closed (422 Not allowlisted).
